root_causes: Diagnostic pan accumulated a sinusoidal offset each frame, producing an FPS-dependent route that leaves the supplied continent.
Cache expired unselected tiles after120 updates, even with unused memory budget.
changes: Pan is an absolute longitude offset of +/-0.25 degrees about its initial location, based on elapsed seconds.
Evict least-recently-used unselected entries only under byte pressure; retain the coarse root.
Log camera longitude/latitude alongside the terrain statistics.

coverage_analysis.method: Independent selector/coverage calculation; 273 spherical ground rays per camera, actual fine mask. Old helper sampled every second at120fps, assumed first app update at2.75s (matching reported startup).

tests.actual_package_sweep: 451 camera samples across45 seconds at60km,25S,108E;12..14 selected,never zero
regressions: long absence retains cached geometry below budget
LRU refresh protects revisited tiles; pressure releases the older mesh
coarse root and cold tiles remain while looking away

validation_environment: UNIVERSE_TEST=1, workspace8 verified, auto-no-vsync, Vulkan RTX5090. Reflink package snapshot.
limits: The supplied pyramid covers one land region. Empty selections outside that coverage remain correct.
Selected working geometry is protected from eviction; the measured run remained below the256MiB cache target.
Capture timings include startup and hidden workspace presentation; no interactive benchmark claim.
